items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.data with block_public_acls=true, ignore_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, and restrict_public_buckets=true.

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block to aws_s3_bucket.data and set apply_server_side_encryption_by_default.sse_algorithm to aws:kms or AES256.

items.known: CKV_AWS_18 Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a logging block to aws_s3_bucket.data with target_bucket set to a dedicated log bucket such as aws_s3_bucket.logs.id and an appropriate target_prefix.

items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a versioning block to aws_s3_bucket.data with enabled = true.
